comment: Independent allmain.c moveloop_core() witness for a second movement allocation after a mid-scan polymorph. A debug Wizard wishes for plate mail, a large shield and potions of gain level (several later letters do not match this seed's inventory, so those commands only prompt), drops her cloak of magic resistance and stands beside a genetic engineer. Its AD_POLY hits (uhitm.c mhitm_ad_poly(), mhitm.c mon_poly(), polyself.c polyself()) change her form repeatedly; at T:42 a Stressed form becomes an unburdened one slower than 12, so u_calc_moveamt() needs two allocations before she moves again. The resumed elapsed-turn plan for an unburdened hero counts only one, and the port used to compare that count under the first, burdened plan's gate and stop with "elapsed-turn preflight disagreed with live allocation count".
